exposure: SNP rs2736100 of human telomerase reverse transcriptase (hTERT) gene (C variant allele)
Fitzpatrick type 4 phototype / dark skin tone
outcome: Patient Observer Scar Assessment Scale (POSAS) value
cohort: The study included 71 female patients who had undergone Caesarean section, developed hypertrophic and atrophic scars, and belonged to a Caucasian population group.
finding: The C variant allele of hTERT SNP rs2736100 showed a borderline statistically significant association with the risk of developing pathological scarring, and a pre-conceptional BMI >25 kg/m^2 and dark skin tone were also associated with abnormal scar formation in this cohort.
